scene.style: flat vector illustration, layered paper-cutout silhouettes, minimal geometric shapes, no textures, no grain, no photorealism

sky.stars: sparse small white dots, upper half only
sky.clouds: one single-line outline cloud, no fill, color #948e84, upper corner, kept clear of frame center

moon.shape: flat circle, upper two-thirds of frame
moon.edge_glow: soft outer glow, color #a57534, opacity 15%. soft inner glow, color #94e6ee, opacity 15%
moon.note: the moon's disc sits behind the center safe zone, but nothing else should render inside it

hills.placement: left and right thirds only, receding toward the horizon, kept clear of frame center

path.style: short winding ribbon, visible only in the lower third, fading to nothing as it approaches the center safe zone
path.glow: none — no emblem exists yet to cast light, keep the path matte
path.object: single flat folded-document/page icon, soft blur #94e6ee, resting at the path's near end

safe_zones.name: logo_zone
safe_zones.description: must stay flat, empty, and unobstructed — the real product logo (a separate vector asset) will be composited here in code. Do not draw any emblem, mark, or focal object inside this circle.

safe_zones.name: copy_zone
safe_zones.description: must stay flat solid #16181c with no scene elements — the real HTML headline, subhead, and button render here outside the image.

style_keywords: background plate designed to have a separate logo asset composited on top
same visual family as the Feed empty-state asset, only the path emblem changes
negative_prompt: any emblem, badge, icon, or focal mark in the center
paper plane (reserved for the Feed asset — use the document icon instead)
